title: Derivation of Pressure Exerted by Gas
notes: **Setup:** consider a cubical container of side $L$ containing $N$ molecules of mass $m$.
**Momentum change per collision:** a molecule with $x$-component of velocity $v_x$ rebounds with $-v_x$, so momentum change is $2mv_x$.
**Time between collisions:** the molecule travels distance $2L$ between successive wall collisions, taking time $\Delta t = 2L/v_x$.
**Pressure:** $P = \frac{F}{A} = \frac{mv_x^2}{L^3} = \frac{mv_x^2}{V}$. Averaging over all molecules gives $P = \frac{Nm\langle v_x^2 \rangle}{V}$.
**Final result:** using $\langle v_x^2 \rangle = \frac{1}{3}\langle v^2 \rangle$, we get $PV = \frac{1}{3}Nm\langle v^2 \rangle = \frac{2}{3}N\langle K \rangle$.
